title: Fix three bugs in BankAccount class
description: Fix three bugs in a BankAccount class: deposit doesn't update balance, withdraw allows overdraft without check, get_balance returns wrong field.

files.tests/test_bank.py:
import pytest
from src.bank import BankAccount

def test_deposit_increases_balance():
    a = BankAccount("alice", 100.0)
    a.deposit(50.0)
    assert a.get_balance() == 150.0

def test_withdraw_decreases_balance():
    a = BankAccount("alice", 100.0)
    a.withdraw(30.0)
    assert a.get_balance() == 70.0

def test_withdraw_overdraft_raises():
    a = BankAccount("alice", 50.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        a.withdraw(100.0)

def test_get_balance_returns_float():
    a = BankAccount("alice", 200.0)
    assert isinstance(a.get_balance(), float)

def test_transfer():
    a = BankAccount("alice", 100.0)
    b = BankAccount("bob", 0.0)
    a.transfer(b, 40.0)
    assert a.get_balance() == 60.0
    assert b.get_balance() == 40.0

task_spec.prompt:
The BankAccount class has three bugs:
1. `deposit` uses subtraction instead of addition — fix to `self._balance += amount`
2. `withdraw` has no overdraft guard — add `if amount > self._balance: raise ValueError("insufficient funds")`
3. `get_balance` returns `self.owner` instead of `self._balance` — fix the return value
All five tests should pass after your fix.
